radioGuide.title: Stick movement guide
radioGuide.centres: Centre the right stick and the left stick horizontally. Keep throttle fully down, then save the stick centres.
radioGuide.throttle: Left stick up and down: move throttle between its lowest and highest endpoints.
radioGuide.yaw: Left stick left and right: keep throttle fully down.
radioGuide.pitch: Right stick up and down: keep {roll} centred.
radioGuide.roll: Right stick left and right: keep {pitch} centred.
radioGuide.range: Move both sticks around, reaching every endpoint until the countdown ends.
radioGuide.live: Teal: your radio’s actual stick positions.
radioGuide.noRadio: Connect a USB radio to see live feedback too.
radioGuide.aria: 3D Mode 2 radio with an animated stick movement guide

settings.actionBindingsHint: Assign a button or an AUX switch. Press Assign, then press a button or move an unused channel to its end. Flight stick channels are excluded. Buttons toggle ARM; AUX on arms and AUX off disarms. Arming requires low throttle. Saved for this device.
settings.bindingWait: {action}: press a button or move an AUX switch within 12 seconds. Release held controls first.
hud.touchHint: ARM switches the motors on/off. Use a radio or controller to fly.
hud.screenToArm: Use ARM below to start the motors
hud.armAlternative: Or use the ARM button at the bottom left.
hud.armRadioSetup: Open Settings and run stick detection before arming.
hud.helpLive: Flight continues while this panel is open. Use Menu to pause and disarm.
hud.helpKeyboard: ARM switches the motors on/off. Lower throttle before arming. You can change key bindings in Settings.
hud.helpRadio: Mode 2: left stick controls throttle and yaw; right stick controls pitch and roll. Assign buttons or switches in Settings. The on-screen buttons also work by touch.
settings.radioMissing: This USB layout has no verified automatic mapping. Detect the sticks using your existing radio model. Android help is only needed if a stick signal is actually missing.
settings.radioMobileRecipe: First try stick detection with your existing radio model; a separate SIM model is usually unnecessary. Raw USB signals show whether the stick axis moves. If all four stick signals do not reach the browser and Advanced USB is available, map Ail/Ele/Thr/Rud to X/Y/Z/Rz. With Classic USB a separate SIM model can be a workaround: CH1=Ail, CH2=Ele, CH3=Thr, CH4=Thr, CH5=Rud, CH6=Rud; select “Android SIM model” here. Do not change the mixes of your real-flight model for this.
stickSetup.startHint: Start with throttle fully down and the other stick axes centred. Four short movements find the channels and directions automatically.
stickSetup.throttle: Raise throttle fully, then lower it fully. Do not touch switches.
stickSetup.yaw: Move the left stick fully right, then centre it.
stickSetup.pitch: Move the right stick fully forward, then centre it.
stickSetup.roll: Move the right stick fully right, then centre it.
stickSetup.noAnalog: No unused analogue movement found. Move only the instructed stick smoothly through its full travel. A switch is not a stick. If a channel is missing, see Android help.
stickSetup.oneDirection: Move only in the indicated direction, then return to the starting position and try again.
online.menuHint: Join a public room or enter a code. To host, choose your drone, map and shared rules below.
online.readyHint: Everyone must be ready before the host can start.
online.inProgress: Session in progress. Resume your flight or leave the room.
simulation.hostSetupHint: These rules apply to everyone in your room. The host can change them in the lobby before starting.
stickSetup.usbCount: The browser exposes {count} axes. These are USB axis numbers, not radio channel numbers.
stickSetup.signalwaiting: No axis movement has appeared during this step yet. Move the indicated stick slowly.
stickSetup.signaldetected: Analogue movement detected: A{axis} · signal change {travel}%. Return the stick, then press “Movement done”.
stickSetup.signalused: A{axis} belongs to a previously detected stick. Move only the indicated axis now.
stickSetup.signaldigital: A{axis} changes, but only a few positions have appeared so far. Move the stick slowly; a switch is not an analogue axis.
stickSetup.signalweak: Small signal change on A{axis} ({travel}%). Move the indicated stick slowly through its full travel.
online.recovering: Reconnecting to room {code}. Your slot is reserved for one minute after connection loss.
online.restored: Connection restored · back in the room. Arm again to fly.
online.recoveryExpired: Automatic return is no longer available. Join again or create a room.
results.title: Run results
results.waiting: Other pilots are still racing. These results update live.
results.complete: This run has ended. The host can prepare another run in the same room.
settings.cameraPerDrone: Camera tilt and field of view are saved separately for each drone.
hud.turtleReady: Turtle mode: throttle down → ARM → use roll or pitch. After recovery: DISARM → Turtle off.
hud.turtleActive: Turtle mode · Use the right stick or arrow keys to flip. After recovery: DISARM → Turtle off.
